description: This file defines the SchemaService class responsible for creating and caching GraphQL schemas within the OrchardCore project, utilizing dependency injection, concurrency control, and schema building logic.

classes.name: SchemaService
classes.description: A service class that constructs and manages GraphQL schemas, supporting caching and concurrency control.

methods.name: GetSchemaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves or creates a GraphQL schema, with caching based on culture and schema identifiers, ensuring thread safety.
